question: Why did New York City get the area code 212 in 1947, rather than, say, 909?
answer: Because 212 was among the quickest to dial. A rotary dial sends one pulse per unit, ten for 0, so 2-1-2 took five pulses against 28 for 9-0-9. The 1947 plan gave big cities the fastest: Los Angeles 213, Chicago 312. Each had 0 or 1 in the middle, unlike any local exchange code.
move: Where every user pays a small cost, give the cheapest option to the most users.

diagram.caption: On a rotary dial, the biggest cities got the codes quickest to dial.

reference: Nunn, Nationwide Numbering Plan, Bell System Technical Journal, 1952
